comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
## Editorial pass 2026-08-29

Best-researched story here, weakest assignment. The research already contains the article; nobody has written it into the plan.

**The assignment is a topic, not a story.** "Name the trend, Ralph is the hook, cover /loop and /goal" produces a listicle. But research.md's own Distinction section is a genuinely good spine:

> Ralph = same prompt, fresh context, files/git as memory, loop until done.
> Product `/goal` = keep this session going until a condition.
> Product `/loop` = re-run on an interval.
> Cousins, not the same command.

That is the piece: **the industry shipped three different verbs and called them all Ralph.** VentureBeat already framed it as "a tale of two Ralphs," so the confusion is real, public, and worth clearing up. Recommend writing that into assignment.md before copy.

**The name correction is a real beat, not a footnote.** Ryan said Wiggins; it is Wiggum; Wiggum was himself named after Ralph Kramden. And Huntley never wrote the "he fails and tries again" gloss — later writers added it. A term whose folklore accreted meaning it never had, in a piece about a term whose meaning got muddied. Use it.

**Make the funny material structural.** repomirror's agent that pkill'd itself. 1,966 iterations of the same question. `/cancel-ralph` being ignored (issue #65). Huntley's own "you'll wake up to a broken codebase that doesn't compile." That is the cost section. A loop-engineering piece with no failure section is irresponsible, and this one already has the material.

**Shelf life.** The command table is the fastest-rotting thing on this board. Cursor's `/goal` is explicitly "Rolling out." Codex has no `/loop`. Recheck the whole table immediately before publish, not now.

**Research: none needed.** Status is behind the artifacts — `assignment` but research.md exists. Should walk to `research` then `report`.
